notes:
Summary: mid-market SaaS (ITSM) product org evaluating Redwood for internal helpdesk/chat agent. Primary goal: fast, reliable internal chat that agents use to augment replies and to triage tickets. Starting with Hosted API for speed of onboarding; will evaluate Dedicated after POC for predictable throughput and isolation.

Key requirements / quotes:
- Latency SLO: 150-250ms tail for agent-facing streaming responses. Need streaming + incremental token delivery.
- Tool calling: MUST be able to call ServiceNow API (create/update tickets) and internal escalation workflow (function/tool-calling/structured outputs). "It needs to keyboard-press like a real agent" — Sr Product PM.
- Audit & retention: retained audit logs for 12 months; immutable activity logs for compliance reviews. Must have per-request metadata (user-id, ticket-id, model-version).
- Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2, KMS for key management, data residency in NA preferred. Need support for retention controls and legal hold.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — will accept some premium for latency guarantees but expect clear TCO between Hosted vs Dedicated.

- 2026-02-18: inbound demo request via website form (product team).
- 2026-02-24: discovery call with Emily Chen (AE), Rafael Ortiz (SE) — demo scheduled.

- Measure: latency distribution (p50/p90/p99), streaming quality, tool-call success rate, hallucination/KB recall metrics.
- Deliverable: POC report + recommendation to go Hosted for pilot or move to Dedicated for production.
